purpose: Create an isolated, versioned XMM reduction and spectral-fitting environment. This gate installs software and calibration files only; it does not run cifbuild, odfingest, EPIC reduction, event filtering, image creation, or array inspection.
known_before_freeze: The complete public archive acquisition passed its size, category, ETag, SHA-256, and no-partial-file gates.
The host has WSL Ubuntu 24.04 on x86_64, mamba 2.5.0, and sufficient local storage.
No usable SAS or HEASoft command was present in the default shell.
SAS 22.1.0 is the current official Ubuntu 24.04 binary exposed by HEASARC; HEASoft 6.36 is the current release and has an official conda package.
HEASARC states that XSPEC model use requires the separate xspec-data package and that the XMM CCF is distributed separately from SAS.

The exact SAS archive was downloaded without extraction and has 1,534,501,526 bytes, SHA-256 f8085d71b0231b9b21fc7a4545746c948f4bc5920d7fa7cce953b2b560bed88c, ETag 5b76a296-62f869dcf5e00, and Last-Modified 2025-03-04T16:18:00Z.

Inspection of only the outer archive member names and install.sh showed that the installer creates the child directory xmmsas_22.1.0-a8f2c2afa-20250304. No executable, calibration, event, image, or science array was opened.

sas.download_policy: Download exactly this archive, record its byte count and SHA-256 before extraction, retain the archive, and reject redirects to a differently named build.
sas.install_policy: Extract the outer archive under sas_install_parent and let the unmodified official install.sh create the declared sas_prefix child. Do not modify a system SAS installation or shell startup files.

heasoft.environment_policy: Create an exact-prefix environment separate from the DRAGONS environment. Export an explicit package URL lock and package inventory after solving.

ccf.snapshot_policy: Mirror once into the dated directory, then write a sorted SHA-256 manifest and never update this directory during the frozen run. Any later CCF refresh must use a new dated directory and a new protocol.
ccf.cif_policy: For ObsID 0093030201, run cifbuild only after the event-processing protocol is separately frozen. Set SAS_CCFPATH to this snapshot and set analysisdate=2026-07-27 so later calibration releases cannot enter this run.

environment_gate.failure: Stop before cifbuild or odfingest if any version, checksum, command, package-lock, or CCF-snapshot gate fails. Do not substitute an unpinned system tool or a newer calibration directory.

provenance_sources.claim: SAS 22.1.0 has an exact Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 binary build.
